translation:
Right page:

That which is sought and consumed as pleasurable and desirable for every delight and appetite — between the two sweet substances — is that the proper administration is established, for the body benefits when the physician directs its humors and softens its pathways, moistening and relieving them, and this drives away harm. It is remarkable how broadly it works against roughness and ailments, nurturing the body. The fundamental point is that we have explained at length, among the physicians, that it is not necessary that what is consumed be the most excellent of what the body knows, so long as it is something that increases in every measure the natural temperament. What the physicians advise is that one be guided toward what is suitable for the body's constitution and adapted to its needs. The appropriate matter facilitates the dissolution when it is suited to the temperament, accepted by the body and absorbed. It eases the constitution when it acts as a support for the body's moisture and its affinity. When mixed properly, it conveys the needed quality to the compound, producing the beneficial outcome. It is recognized that the gentle and refined approach, used with kindness and moderation, is better for guiding one toward safety and comfort. Its benefits are well known and its effects sound, though differences of opinion exist regarding it.

Left page:

Know that whatever is tried in this regard — how it acts on the dry and cold constitution in certain regions as a benefit — is established through proper method. It helps the two healthy types and repairs what has been disrupted in the general balance of the body's humors and moistures. When the constitution encounters this, it corrects its disorder, and the natural softening agents and the pleasant things heal and restore it. The gentle substance — when combined with the moistening agents — rectifies the excessive dryness in the body, and what is most excellent of the compound remedies is what brings together the pleasant and the softening for the purpose of restoration. The best remedy combines these qualities — the pleasant with the corrective — and produces results suitable to the body's natural state, ridding it of hardness and tension. The softening agents and the digestives are proven reliable in dissolving what has accumulated within the body, and the named varieties of the first category are established in their action upon the humors. This has been well demonstrated through experimentation with various preparations over time. The combination of pleasant and dissolving agents is used across all types in every season, and it is administered in the form of a compound. In the preparations used regularly to support the digestion and constitution — the natural softening compound — its administration dissolves rigidity and relieves constriction, including when applied in the case of eggplant preparations.

translation:
Left Page (308):

The major [section], one third of a mithqal, which constitutes the single [simple] medicines of the city.
Chapter on the discussion and clarification of simple medicines.

Our saying regarding simple medicines — and what is meant by them — and what resembles them in their qualities: the major actions and examples are universal, such as the satanic [forces], attraction, and similar things, and the actions of purging, such as those of dominion, and those which cause putrefaction, such as what causes putrefaction in the body, and things resembling that. As for the nutritive, the fertile, and offspring, and things resembling that — if they were compounds, their particulars would be limited, and if their particulars were limited, then the major [quality] would encompass them, as the great is encompassed within the lesser. The house encompasses all the actions of the great actions, whether in terms of assets or quarters. Eating is permissible, such as what is eaten among the four [humors], good and pleasant. The compound ones and the absorbed among them — what is universal among them is that their imitation is like theirs, established. Some of them are found to be like the nourishing and like the foundations. And the type is named by its qualities, and the likeness is the similitude or its counterpart among them.

Right Page:

They take their names and resemble the first, producing what increases; but they place it and extend it in every direction, without sending it to the country [illegible]. In proximity, the pen moves to the eighth part, where subtle transactions occur in stages. It was such that the Yazidans come to make the longitudinal [fibers] accessible from the source. The fourth [quality] — that of the great — covers all the narrations and matters from it. Praise be, the living absolutely, what is produced from what resembles it, and its depth — all of it refers to the physicians, for they know what is proper, settling and soothing. From the loose and the spirit, there is a description: at night, the replenishment of their nourishment dissolves or strengthens, and their correction toward the vapors and every good fragrance for all of that together is what is best in it. And it is thus composed — and indeed, when we examine them, verifying them, they are not to be opened, and all of them, as the first, are found in their repository, the children of God. And he showed the benefit and the useful, or the chains, as a foundation, and some of them were the clothes, and by itself toward the natural [quality], the blacks, or the harmful striking in clothes. If the natural quality in the type is poor, leading it and directing it, the mountains are inclined toward a natural increase. If the natural quality leads toward the edge of the matter, composed and wonderful — what is in the paths of that.

translation: [illegible] As for the organs that receive nourishment, they accept it and retain it for a period, then digest it and absorb it, expel its waste, and are nourished by it — this occurring after it has become blood within the veins. These organs are the liver, the spleen, the kidneys, and the rest of the organs. [illegible] As for the organs that expel wastes: among them are those that expel the waste of the first digestion, namely the stomach and intestines, and among them are those that expel the waste of the second digestion, namely the liver, the gallbladder, the spleen, and the kidneys. [illegible] As for the faculties by which these functions are completed, they are three: the attractive faculty, the retentive faculty, the digestive faculty, and the expulsive faculty. The attractive faculty draws nourishment to the organ; the retentive faculty holds it there until digestion is complete; the digestive faculty digests it and transforms it into a substance resembling the organ; and the expulsive faculty expels the waste from it. [illegible] As for the spirits, they are three: the natural spirit, whose seat is the liver; the animal spirit, whose seat is the heart; and the psychic spirit, whose seat is the brain. The natural spirit flows with the blood through the veins and carries out the functions of the natural faculty. The animal spirit flows through the arteries and carries out the functions of the vital faculty. The psychic spirit flows through the nerves and carries out the functions of the psychic faculty. Right page:

Rather, the explanations are that these subtle matters, by virtue of their fineness, dissolve and pass through every opening — they are openers, breakers, and extractors through every outlet. The burning quality repels and expels what has accumulated within, and its subtle nature draws out the phlegm from every passage. It has other properties as an astringent, compressing the passages and preventing excess of the dominant humor, and among its properties is that it is gentle, facilitating movement, refining the matter that accumulates. Among the qualities of the finest type is that it is balanced, gentle, and easy; it condenses and compresses every dense substance and refines it. The fundamental principle is that it works to break up and dissolve what has congealed in the passages, to clarify the subtle liquid humor, and to direct it to a measured outflow. It moves the volatile substances, awakens the latent powers, and acts upon the dominant humor in the organs of filtration. It assists in thinning and in raising and lowering the dominant humor in the body according to its nature.

Left page:

As was mentioned previously, what passes through the narrow channels and distills through the pores — what is subtle passes through what is subtle; and what is coarse does not pass through except to the larger passages. The subtle nature of a thing is what causes it to penetrate and be absorbed through the skin and surface. The fundamental principle of purity is that it purifies the original substance, and this is most like the nature of the dominant faculty. The dominant faculty and its purification of itself — the gross and the subtle both emerge from it in their various degrees. This is found in the skin and in what opens and facilitates the dominant substance — so that it moves toward what is finest in the lateral passages. The subtle and delicate substance refines and reduces and normalizes the dominant humor. Every sharp, fine, and penetrating subtle thing opens the channels and moves through them. Every subtle matter penetrates and extracts from the joint and the adjacent parts, dissolving what accumulates. The whole of the subtle matters move, awakening what is latent, bringing about the dissolution of accumulations. This causes the dominant matter to thin, benefiting the organs and facilitating the seasonal purging, removing the causes and the obstructions, and what has been mentioned of its benefits in the seasonal passages will assist in removing what has settled.

On the imprisonment [of humors] in the body: when vapors are moderated and balanced, they become like a moist bandage combined with sour substances for the liver. Second, regarding the servant — when swelling occurs and [treatment] is administered, one considers the day when the mountain [of illness] settles. He who examines the causes of flowering and moisture — and verifies the matter — will find that dissolution and elimination of waste are among the first [treatments]. One who understands the settling of heaviness and weight upon the body, and whose nature is disposed to accept [treatment], will find ease through nourishment from what the constitution requires. The two qualities [hot and cold] are examined, and what is mixed and filtered [from the body] is considered. As for the compound [remedy], it acts in the body by means of its mixture — reaching what it contacts and correcting it. Every natural preparation refers to the organs of the body and what moves the physician to consider the face of swelling and its treatment. On the treatment of chronic conditions: tightening of the arteries in the extremities and the joints for some time afterward.

Left page:

In its placement, it settles in the passages and in the subjects of investigation — what resembles it and what is drawn toward it in terms of bodily constitution. The virtues and governing faculties, each in its place, act upon what is within and change it. The fundamental [quality] draws moisture between the flesh, settling upon the corrupted humors. Each dissolving [agent] works upon what it dissolves, restoring the affected area. As for the mixture — it is that which refines and perfects the natural faculty between the required [qualities]. The blended and the isolated are compared, combining the beneficial and the corrective together. What is set apart from the ideal [composition] — its surface and structure [are examined]. It is found from what is consistent and unified — the natural temperament and the combined [factors]. Regarding the faculties: [they are distributed] from one region to another, and the temperament [of each organ is considered]. As for the matter of moistness — gold [as remedy] and the surrounding [elements]: whenever this occurs repeatedly, all of it points to [the correct treatment].

Left page (312):

Among its properties is that it preserves the vital spirit within the body from disease. The name of the breast preparation is that it is compounded from fine and wholesome ingredients, and it resembles in nature the second class of natural preparations, being among the refined substances. The secondary and softening preparations are named after the beneficials, and it follows necessarily that there should be no separation between them. Neither the laxative with the astringents nor the softeners, for both are well-known, and every medicine that combines a laxative with an astringent — as in the case of the two substances — is beneficial in joint pains, because the laxative power first draws out the matter, and the astringent power then, in two strengths, moves the matter without dispersing what is essential to it. Every medicine that is smooth and fine in texture corrupts the joints and ages them, as do inflammatory lymphatic swellings. The thick and heavy, combined together, are between the laxative and the emollient, but the matter that prevents persistence — as is the local custom — does not describe the burdens and the local treatments. The thickening in its affinity and in its drawing away from it, and what prevents hot inflammations in accompanying them toward inflammation, and both resemble a repellent, and what disperses and resolves the matter — the compound with cold repels from the ear, benefiting it and those that follow.

Right page:

هو المادة الذي عنده ناج الروح الساري الكائن من ناحية رطوبته ما الجليل
حتى يصل إلى إن تعرفه السليم إن يحسن والد الكائن من رطوبته وحلال
تطيبه إلى يخرج من طبيعة إذ أبك بمل بها أعلام أو المرتب فيعقر
هذا قبل التلبيخ والمناسبة إذا كان القوة المنتقى الذي يصعب من الجلالين إذا الجا
مخففاً تسليه ويمكن له هذا الجليل بما يوم الجليل لجمع خلط
أبل ليأمر فيخه وصحيح حركته ويستعمل فيصير الله من استدار بين
يتوما خلط الدلج والملطخاً والماسير المادة الذي أسيل من نافد لطيف
بلاده الجلال أحد ما الجلال قائده ما المبطل المبطل الزارونيد وكل يقع
الهنى والكلف وتجمع ما وأسيل بما المدة سيقع من الأيد بعد أولى إلى ذلك سلك
فأو المعصر ومناجر حتى من قبول المقبول المنسبة الكائن به والمأت إذا
لأحسنه فيه ما لكل تلطيف المجموع والمأوى إلى الاعلال أدى رأسه صبه
ما هوائن ويتحن ما الهوارد عن طايرها به إذا أولى من ذكر الورد والإج
ومن سأد المادة وبها المادة الذي يمد له ويرده أن يستعل صالح الجمع في الصفع
بدأ ملكت به ويصب من هام كرامه ذاتها وينسبه إليه الجاود إلى الحال الإيه
أوحد من منعه ومن المسألان إلى المعصور وصغر المجموع من قوله مبلغ عنه

Left page:

الملب في إذ الإوراد والمعلطة والمعلطة وعومصاد المجلطف هو المادة الذي المبني من شأنه
ه أسيره يعلو والتوليبه الكائن أعلطها ما أجادها ما أجاد ما أجاد أسار وما خال طبيعه
والمقيم وعومصا أدالحاصلهم والمضم والمضم والمنفهم صالح الذي الأسير إلى يصيل بصبر هنا يرده ملك
اجارات والتلبيخ والمزيل والمزيل والجابر اجادوا في البدا والجابر عجة مجيء عجة منهم منهم
وإذا صب والحدر هو المادة المادة الساريد الذي البني بعض بين المشتعل من إلى أن
يعلن إلى الرجح الحالبه الذي حال الإيه ما في الحكم والحجر إلى في أدرى في من رأجه
طلبناها في يوم ويوم والرجح والرجح الميقات النيا الثانية وعمل ويجلج العصور
كذلك ثلاثة السبل إلى أبر النيئ التنسأ المبلأ التنساف فوق مثل الجالبون والتلبيخ والمطب
معروفه والمقي والمدفع سو كان ريي في جمع ذلك المادة الذي إذا لظيف خلطه إذا ظلف
فبها الجادر الغرني ما يعجل فرعة السجال ريأساسل الجملة اللوثبا ويجمع ما فيه
خومصده ومصله وسار لمن لادبو والأعلاد والمأوى ما يعجل الصلب الحصن
يؤل طبيعه وإلى الى التحملون من قبل المبدإ والمبدإ من قبل المطالة الصلب من هيئة منها
الانبيا وبينه الطبيعه ويكون الصلبة الصلبة وبالنوعه وبالنوعه إلى بأول أدام الأتحل تجمل وسفل
من ابلدنه وابلدنه سيأ بالن ما المعروف والمعروف وإن لا أنبفل وإن لا أنبفل ولكن ما في المدد لكن يصلمها
وفيه بهامها وفيه عزالسلآن إلى المعصور وصغر المعصور ومن إلى ما المعصور وصغر منهما ما نفل في البلد
translation:
Right page:

This is the substance from which the spirit that flows through it is derived, coming from the side of its moisture — the great one. Until it reaches the point where the healthy person recognizes it: that the moisture arising from it is beneficial, and what loosens it and prepares it rises from its nature. This is before the softening and conditioning, when the power of the refined [matter], which is difficult to extract from the two great [humors], is present. It can be lightened and soothed, and the great [matter] can be made to collect the mixed [humors]. It must be moved correctly and used so that God grants its stabilization. The mixed, the smeared, and the flowing fine substance extracted from it enters into it. The great [matter] is led by its guide; the nullifying agents and all zinc compounds are repelled. The greasiness and blemishes collect, and the material flows, reaching the desired goal. The pressed and extracted substances are received and matched appropriately. Everything is refined — the collected and the sheltered — to treat the ailments, poured over the head. The cool breezes and the rose and ginger are most fitting. The substance extends and repels it and makes the collected sound in the compressed area. It is established and poured from its essence, attributed to the eternal state. From its prevention and from the pressed and gathered, its full extent is communicated.

Left page:

The compound — in the context of the veins, the mixed and the conditioned — and the concentrated refined substance is the matter whose nature is known. Its flow rises, and its condition is as best as it can be, its abundance well-arranged, and its nature preserved. The upholder consolidates the outcome, and the strengthener corrects what is needed, going back to the origin. The softening, the removing, the healing, and what aids in the beginning all come together in groups. When poured, the cold flowing substance spreads between the ignited elements, until it reaches the judicious foundation — that which is in the rule and judgment — going back to its source on a given day. The timing and the fixed period and the act of working it and processing it across the eras — likewise, three of the pathways go to the green-raw conditioned softener, like the attractors, the softener, and the suppressant. The known and the repelling work together in a group — that substance, when it is fine in its mixture, if it is gentle. The outer layer accelerates the flow of the fluid, collects what is in it, consolidates it, and makes it whole. Its nature leads toward those who bear it from the origin, and the origin from the flexible strengthened structure. Its nature forms the levels of the solid, and by its types it begins to collect and lower. From its country and its land, what is known will be, and without hindrance in the extended material. From within it, from the sovereign, to the pressed, and from the gathered — what flows in the land.

text:
Right page (verso):

وبشغيل وإنها وإن كان لا تعمل بل تعمد في المعروف ورتبه
ما به ذبه والجلجل والقار وآل وقد وطبه مصلبه مغبه ما نفعه نفي
سلا للجبل وعل وردا لجرجب نه وكل بوادر في المد روف ناقه سنه
داليسا للكل وداكر سنابه إلى بنجلا لهزيه وأحمل نزل ما لو بعض صمعفبله سبها
الحركة كلغوا المغفبله الهزيه واعوا الحركة استلن لن فاللبال
الطلمب وإذ لعي على فونها ما بوددن وطيبه المصول والزالها
سبلادة سلع السير والماز وفي المنج الفريمه هوالمداد الرطب
الذي هو الطر الطواطب المعروف مصر فيه جم المعروف الجفيف والدبال
والمروق هو المداد الذي بل جرح موبطا لذين منيش فيه صبي سمه
عنه وجسبار له أما اليا اليا استلان المبها المسفاد بجا لطبه لوترقوا كل
من يباس أسملها الطسيع وقال القعي العدالبصه كالل اسرع إشهاله والملك
فا الله عا الله ركن الذي بنجا في نبه ان فيه به على من قطر على بعض صبن بسلطا اللك
المسلح وضبر ظلم لكل يجسم به الملب صبنوا عصبه لبه أن يسبل لبو رفع به
سبيط مثال الأسباط والمجففه هوالله الذاليالذي هوالله الذاليه لطيله
لطقه داللماس قيم الله الله المداد صدت في المتصف يق صوله لأول الجماع

Left page (recto):

لص
بلما التهوين بارك

مليات فيضان وبقد من الجهل أف
الخلايا المبنه الأطنا لجصا إن سمع
وظهر وطالما الحق الله لجموز وبليات الملشه
الكلام ابن الكلما الله الكلما بيابي عشك
في الملا الله فالملاث
علما ينبع له المفرده المنفرده
ادل الله يا به المرنيه
ما تساعد فنا شاتساعد بقع انساب الملامات بضبه ليما
من كل ابند آلاظا آلاظاما يبي وفند وفنه اللاح المذكر
يا بام أكمله بيت الله اليد آلاما يبي علم جلج كل محر
شاء الله شافا صافي يا بنه هـ والحمد لله رب العالمين

في التلوع ذا لا إلا شتر بيا ما لا صلاة
تلا بلا مه يا زيد بيه الطالمين
في شافيا الملا وضع يصبر عشنا
بلا بيد لحك
translation:
Right page:

On the operation and function of medicines: even if they do not act directly, they are directed toward known remedies and their ordering. What benefits them is preparation, their benefit being drawn from the mountain aloe and the galbanum and pitch and their equivalents, each being prepared and refined, beneficial to the throat in measured doses. For all cases, one should consider the balance and proportion, carrying what is needed to relieve the affected part. The motion must be gentle and gradual, allowing it to settle slowly. When the fluid is absorbed, what is within it is drawn out by the vessels and dispersed. The moist medicinal paste — which is the known dried compound of Egypt — is used when the wound is moist. The liquid medium is that which moistens a wound for those in whom some symptom has appeared. It must be taken gradually; the medicinal substance reaches the organ to increase flow. The physician must judge each case by the body's constitution, applying the compound carefully so that it may be absorbed gently. The bandages and desiccants are those that God has made beneficial as a fine application, and the foundation of all is the medium that settles in the moderate zone at the beginning of intercourse.

Left page:

In the name of God, the blessed and exalted.

On the lessening of heaviness and its blessing:

Abundant flows of knowledge have come from ignorance away —
The cells are built, the limbs have heard the call.
The truth of God has appeared, and his gifts are manifold.
The speech of the son of wisdom, by the grace of God.
In the assembly of God, the praised ones —
Knowledge flows from its singular, unique source.
By the justice of God, O Day of Return —
What aided us, what came as aid, the signs and marks of grace.
From every bond, the great matters are mentioned.
In the name of God, completed; the praise belongs to God, Lord of the Worlds.

In devotion there is no god but He — no prayer is accepted without presence.
Recite, without haste, O Zayd, among the seekers.
In healing the assembly, patience is placed upon us.
Without a hand, there is judgment.
